summary: Implemented bounded REPORT calendar-multiget within one authorized collection: parses hrefs, bulk-resolves resources, and returns per-resource DAV statuses (200 with calendar-data/ETag, per-item 404 for missing or foreign hrefs).
follow_up: Recurring/all-day events return per-item 404 in multiget (consistent with T04/T05 exposure); T13/T14 will need to extend ical_and_etag and the recurring check.
Per-href recurring check issues one extra EXISTS query; bounded by MAX_MULTIGET_HREFS=1000.
important_context: REPORT handler now dispatches via query::parse_calendar_report (shared with calendar-query).

Exposure rules unchanged: only timed, non-recurring events hydrate; hrefs must be within the authorized collection (href_within_collection rejects foreign/traversal paths before any cross-calendar lookup).
dst_check.rs was whitespace-reformatted only by the project cargo fmt lint gate (no behavior change).
